groups.name: zero-trust.audit
groups.description: Security event auditing: structured logs, Micrometer counters, and optional in-memory store for API access.

properties.name: zero-trust.audit.enabled
properties.description: Enable audit logging and metrics emission for security events.

properties.name: zero-trust.audit.log-success
properties.description: When true, AUTHENTICATION_SUCCESS events are persisted in the in-memory store.

properties.name: zero-trust.audit.log-failures
properties.description: When true, AUTHENTICATION_FAILURE, AUTHORIZATION_DENIED, and GUARDRAIL_BLOCKED events are persisted.

properties.name: zero-trust.audit.in-memory-store
properties.description: Enable the in-memory InMemorySecurityEventStore bean. Useful for exposing recent audit events via a REST endpoint.
